get.description:
Liveness probe — the process is up and serving requests.

Deliberately dependency-free: it must not fail because a downstream
subsystem is degraded (that is what readiness is for).

Readiness probe — required dependencies are usable.

The database is required: if it is unreachable the service is not ready
(HTTP 503). RAG is optional and reported as a degraded capability rather
than blocking readiness.

Liveness probe with DB status and optional-subsystem state.

``status`` is ``ok`` only when required dependencies are healthy.
``optional_services`` reports each optional subsystem separately so a
caller can tell "working" apart from "degraded".

post.description:
Anonymous clients get a *new server-owned* session; existing sessions need proof.

Never mint a bearer credential for an unauthenticated, caller-selected ID:
that would turn knowledge of a session ID into access to its profile.

post.description:
Search the knowledge base for relevant content.

Returns ``has_evidence=false`` with an empty result when the corpus is
healthy but holds nothing relevant. Returns HTTP 503 when retrieval is
disabled or broken, so a caller cannot mistake "unavailable" for "no match".

get.description:
Get knowledge quotes, optionally filtered by major.

The public demo ships no attributed-quote corpus, so this normally returns
an empty list; that is "no quotes available", not an error.

post.description:
Generate a report from the user's real conversation data.

Reads slots (province, score, subject, interest) for the student
profile, then scans recent AI replies to accumulate suggestions,
risks, and action items across multiple turns — not just the last one.

Requires the Bearer token bound to ``body.session_id`` so a caller cannot
read another session's conversation by naming its id.
